CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2576 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8. Bus nonce: 4e030b94445cb86f87f436bd597d7054. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8` or `Fix review: blocked fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4e030b94445cb86f87f436bd597d7054`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2576 fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2576-4e030b94`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Delta re-verdict for PR #2576 (roster PR-A, branch fix/audit-r10-roster) at head fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8 (verify with git rev-parse of the PR head and stop if it moved). Your earlier verdict at df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3 stands in the PR comments (first merge verdict, then a carry-routing re-issue). The head moved only because (a) two roster carry appends were pushed to the roster branch by the orchestrator (commits 9dc08aac2 adds a carry to R10-UX-HEALTH, 23ef06dc6 adds one to R10-LIVESTATE: data-only appends of PR #2572's notes, items 6ce59610 and 4c077302) and (b) main was merged in twice (4099baa44, fe1365f0f). Review only the delta: `git diff df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3 fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8 -- dev/programme/rosters/` and confirm the rest of the delta is main's own merge (three-dot against origin/main shows nothing new outside what the PR owned before); run the roster lint gate (brief_lint TOTAL: 0, carry_audit owners no orphan) at the head, git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, check-runs once (pending: say which). Standing rule 19: every observation in your verdict carries a disposition, either `Carry: <GROUP-ID>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster) or `Carry: dismissed <reason of two or more words>`; run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted before returning it. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md; first line `Fix review: merge fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8` or blocked.
